title: Recent Analytical and Computational Developments on the Advection-Diffusion-Reaction Wildfire Model
summary: Wildfires represent a problem for ecosystems, human activities, and economies, driven by the climate crisis and land-use changes. Predicting wildfire propagation through mathematical modelling is essential for damage mitigation and risk assessment. This paper provides a comprehensive review of a physics-based Advection-Diffusion-Reaction (ADR) model, focusing on the balance between physical accuracy and computational efficiency.
